blurb: Guests board the River Skipper II, a 45-foot USCG-inspected commercial tiki vessel that holds up to 40 passengers. They can join daily scheduled public tours or book private charters for custom events. Tours include wildlife watching, history narration, sunset cruises, pub crawls, and beach days at local sandbars.
extraNote: BYOB allowed, bring your own food and drinks · USCG inspected annually for safety · Three pickup locations: Regatta Pointe Marina in Palmetto, Bradenton Riverwalk downtown, and Anna Maria Island (scheduled pickups)
